answer: In an agent economy, requiring each new identity to post a substantial stake locked for a period and subject to slashing on detected misbehavior makes Sybil creation costly. An attacker who tries to wander the network spawning clones would need an ocean of capital, each lantern of stake illuminating a potential loss that scales with the number of fakes, rendering large attacks uneconomical as total locked value exceeds any gain from spam or capture.
